items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was the grandfather of Patty Hearst that we've heard much about in recent years.

ctx.x: He was the grandfather of Patty Hearst that we've heard much about in recent years.

Did his attitude towards the black musicians effect where, how and when they worked? He had so much influence over the general picture of Los Angeles; did his strong anti-black feelings effect the black musician?
